 SSC CPO 2026 Exam City Details Released: When Will the Admit Card Be Out? 
 The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the examination city details for candidates appearing in the SSC CPO 2026 Paper-I examination. Candidates can now check their allotted examination city by logging into the official SSC website at ssc.gov.in.
 The SSC CPO Paper-I examination is scheduled to be conducted from November 23 to November 28, 2026. The recruitment examination is being held for the selection of Sub-Inspectors in Delhi Police and the Central Armed Police Forces (CAPFs).
 The Commission has clarified that the admit card will be made available approximately two to three days before the respective examination date. Therefore, candidates should not confuse the exam city intimation with the final admission certificate.
 SSC CPO 2026 Exam: Key Dates 
 Exam city details: Released
 Paper-I examination: November 23 to 28, 2026
 Admit card: Approximately 2-3 days before the respective exam date
 Class 10 marksheet upload deadline for affected candidates: November 20, 2026
 Official website: ssc.gov.in
 SSC CPO 2026 Exam City Details 
 Candidates who have registered for the examination can view their allotted exam city through the designated login module on the SSC website.
 The city information has been released ahead of the Paper-I examination to help candidates make the necessary travel and examination arrangements.
 The SSC CPO Paper-I examination will be conducted from November 23 to 28, 2026. Candidates should regularly check the official website for updates regarding their admission certificate and examination-related instructions.
 SSC CPO Admit Card 2026 Release Date 
 The SSC has stated that the admission certificate, or admit card, will tentatively be available two to three days before the candidate's respective examination date.
 This means candidates whose examination is scheduled earlier in the examination window are expected to receive their admit cards earlier than those appearing on later dates.
 The admit card is an important document for entry to the examination centre. Candidates should download it as soon as it becomes available and carefully check the details mentioned on it.
 How To Check SSC CPO 2026 Exam City 
 Candidates can follow these steps to check their allotted examination city:
 Visit the official SSC website at ssc.gov.in.
 Log in through the designated candidate login module.
 Enter the required login credentials.
 Open the City Live / Admit Card Status section for the SSC CPO 2026 examination.
 Check the examination city and other available details.
 Download or save the information for future reference.
 The Commission has advised candidates to use the official SSC website for examination-related updates.
